articles.title: Bitcoin miners’ AI pivot pays off, but mining could revive with one twist
articles.snippet: Miners with AI and high-performance computing contracts have commanded higher valuations as declining bitcoin prices and hashprice squeeze pure-play operators.

articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin tepidly on the rise as stocks slip
articles.snippet: The U.S. 30-year Treasury yield hit its highest since 2007 and Brent crude topped $91 as the Iran conflict escalates, pressuring stocks. Bitcoin is holding its range, for now.

articles.title: Kraken parent Payward joins Anthropic’s Project Glasswing for AI security push
articles.snippet: Payward will use Anthropic’s cybersecurity model to hunt vulnerabilities and share open-source findings.

articles.title: Compound bets $52 million, new leadership team in switch to institutional focus
articles.snippet: The protocol pioneered decentralized finance lending, but assets locked have tumbled from a peak five years ago. Now it's looking to attract institutions after retail traders lost interest.

articles.title: Federal prosecutors blast ex-Celsius CEO’s motion to vacate as ‘without merit’
articles.snippet: Despite already serving a 12-year sentence in federal prison, Alex Mashinsky continues to explore legal avenues to vacate his conviction related to activities at Celsius.
